Round-5 Lemon Yellow Senior UX Designer retest (Hirestepx bug PDF). Three bugs:
  • T2 flat-band leak: 'internal compensation bands range from ₹50 LPA to ₹50 LPA, with a maximum stretch to ₹50 LPA' — every band slot is the candidate's target. Caught by flat-breakdown detector via 'band' wording? No — flat-breakdown requires component keywords. Use phantom-counter / number-echo-misbind. We pin number-echo: AI echoed ₹50 but candidate target is ₹50 (matches), so the failure isn't echo-misbind. Pin via flat-breakdown only if component-words present; this turn isn't pinned cleanly without a new detector. Skip pinning, document the gap.
  • T3 phantom-competing-offer: candidate said NO competing offer, AI replied 'I appreciate you bringing up a competing offer, Jay' — pure fabrication.
  • T5 repeated probe + premature close + trailing question.
